changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE financial.period_results ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, external_id uuid NOT NULL, version smallint NOT NULL, created_on timestamp NOT NULL, last_update timestamp, id_financial_period bigint NOT NULL, revenues numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, expenses numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, result numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT period_results_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT period_results_external_id_key UNIQUE (external_id), CONSTRAINT period_results_id_financial_period_key UNIQUE (id_financial_period), CONSTRAINT fk_financial_periods_on_period_results FOREIGN KEY (id_financial_period) REFERENCES registration.financial_periods (id) );
